entries.name: 🪪 모험가 카드
entries.content:
### Adventurer Card:
- The adventurer's basic information, job, stats, and skill information are registered and automatically updated each time the adventurer levels up or learns a skill.
- You can immediately transfer skills to other adventurers on a card.

entries.name: ---- 직업 ----
entries.content:
### Jobs & Classes:
- Starter Classes: Adventurer, Warrior, Thief, Priest, Wizard
- Specialized Classes: Archer, Knight, Dragon Knight, Creator, Swordsman, Elemental Master, Rune Knight, Witch Doctor, Lancer, Monk, Ranger, Sage
- Advanced Classes: Arch Priest, Arch Wizard, Crusader, Swordmaster, Assassin, Dark Stalker, Dark Knight, Berserk, Necromancer, Sniper
- Other Jobs: Hero, Dragon Slayer, Princess, Merchant, Prosecutor, Monster Tamer, Demon Summoner, Dancer, Farmer, Scholar, Blacksmith, Cook, Lord, Magic Item Craftsman, Fortune Teller

entries.name: 🔰 Adventurer
entries.content:
### Adventurer:
- A general job for those who didn't choose a specific class. They can learn any class or species skill if demonstrated to the Adventurer. Due to poor stats and lack of talent, learning those skills is more expensive and less efficient than specialists, although Adventurers level-up easily.

entries.name: ⚔️ Warrior
entries.content:
### Warrior:
- A vanguard fighter who uses heavy weapons such as swords, shields, and spears. It is the most common class among adventurers.

entries.name: 👤 Thief
entries.content:
### Thief:
- A rogue specialized in dungeon exploration and burglary, but with poor attack skills. It's the second most common class among adventurers.

entries.name: 🙏 Priest
entries.content:
### Priest:
- A cleric who serves a god and uses the power of faith to perform many types of miracles, such as healing magic and support buffs. A Dark Priest serves a dark god.

entries.name: 🧙‍♂️ Wizard
entries.content:
### Wizard:
- A mage who uses all types of magic. It often requires a higher education. It is a rare class as many parties don't have a wizard.

entries.name: 🏹 Archer
entries.content:
### Archer:
- A class specialized in bows and other ranged weapons.

entries.name: 🛡️ Knight
entries.content:
### Knight:
- A noble class that can bolster its own strength through honor and oaths. They work as soldiers and guards for the kingdom.

entries.name: 🐉 Dragon Knight
entries.content:
### Dragon Knight:
- A spearman who forms a covenant with a dragon to raise stats and fight alongside it. A super rare class.

entries.name: ⚗️ Creator
entries.content:
### Creator:
- A mage who uses Creation Magic through magic circles to create golems and such.

entries.name: 🗡️ Swordsman
entries.content:
### Swordsman:
- A fighter skilled in the usage of any bladed weapon, such as swords and daggers.

entries.name: 🌪️ Elemental Master
entries.content:
### Elemental Master:
- A class that calls spirits to bolster powers and create different phenomena.

entries.name: ✡️ Rune Knight
entries.content:
### Rune Knight:
- A knight who uses magical runes on armor and weapons to boost power and draw elemental power from gems.

entries.name: 🕯️ Witch Doctor
entries.content:
### Witch Doctor:
- A shaman who uses powerful curses to combat diseases caused by microbes. Also performs surgeries alongside priests.

entries.name: 🏇 Lancer
entries.content:
### Lancer:
- A fighter specialized in spear-wielding.

entries.name: 👊 Monk
entries.content:
### Monk:
- A cleric who fights barehanded.

entries.name: 👩🏻‍🚒 Ranger
entries.content:
### Ranger:
- A soldier specialized in survival and traps.

entries.name: 📔 Sage
entries.content:
### Sage:
- A druid who can use both elemental, healing, and support magic.

entries.name: ✝️ Arch Priest
entries.content:
### Arch Priest:
- A priest advanced class, specialized in healing magic, support buffs, and holy magic, with enough combat skills to fight in the front row.

entries.name: 🎆 Arch Wizard
entries.content:
### Arch Wizard:
- A wizard advanced class, who can use powerful spells such as Advanced Magic and Special Brand magics.

entries.name: 🛡️ Crusader
entries.content:
### Crusader:
- A paladin with the highest defense stats to protect allies. They can also choose to learn Holy Magic spells.

entries.name: ⚜️ Swordmaster
entries.content:
### Swordmaster:
- A fighter with the highest attack stats. They can combine both physical and magical attacks.

entries.name: 👤 Assassin
entries.content:
### Assassin:
- A thief advanced class, specialized in stealth combat.

entries.name: 🖤 Dark Stalker
entries.content:
### Dark Stalker:
- A class similar to an assassin, specialized in espionage.

entries.name: 🖤 Dark Knight
entries.content:
### Dark Knight:
- The crusader's polar opposite and the Devil King's Royal Guard's class.

entries.name: 🤪 Berserk
entries.content:
### Berserk:
- A vanguard class that requires a violent personality.

entries.name: 👻 Necromancer
entries.content:
### Necromancer:
- A class who can summon the dead as ghosts and the like.

entries.name: 🎯 Sniper
entries.content:
### Sniper:
- An archer advanced class.

entries.name: 🌟 Hero
entries.content:
### Hero:
- Someone who defeated or will likely manage to defeat the Devil King.

entries.name: 🐲 Dragon Slayer
entries.content:
### Dragon Slayer:
- Someone who killed a powerful dragon. It doesn't apply to those who killed weak ones like baby wyverns.

entries.name: 👑 Princess
entries.content:
### Princess:
- A member of royalty. Because of the expensive food full of XP and heritage with heroes from the past, they are extremely powerful fighters.

entries.name: 💰 Merchant
entries.content:
### Merchant:
- A trader who deals with all kinds of business. It requires high Intellect and Luck.

entries.name: ⚖️ Prosecutor
entries.content:
### Prosecutor:
- A police officer who acts as fiscal, interrogator, and district attorney.

entries.name: 🐾 Monster Tamer
entries.content:
### Monster Tamer:
- A general designation for anyone with domestic monsters.

entries.name: 👹 Demon Summoner
entries.content:
### Demon Summoner:
- Someone who, after years of studying and training, can perform delicate rituals to summon demons.

entries.name: 💃  Dancer
entries.content:
### Dancer:
- Someone skilled in both dancing and singing.

entries.name: 🌾 Farmer
entries.content:
### Farmer:
- Someone who farms vegetables. It requires qualification since each vegetable has its own fertilizer preference, temperament, and attack method.

entries.name: 🎓 Scholar
entries.content:
### Scholar:
- A researcher who studies wildlife or magic tools.

entries.name: 🔨 Blacksmith
entries.content:
### Blacksmith:
- A smith who can produce weapons, armors, and tools.

entries.name: 👩🏻‍🍳 Cook
entries.content:
### Cook:
- A chef who can cook any meal they know.

entries.name: 🤴🏻 Lord
entries.content:
### Lord:
- A noble who acts as governor of a certain territory and its cities.

entries.name: 🛠️ Magic Item Craftsman
entries.content:
### Magic Item Craftsman:
- Someone who produces magic items and tools.

entries.name: 🔮 Fortune Teller
entries.content:
### Fortune Teller:
- Someone who can predict other people's future, but not their own, by drawing power from the All-Seeing Demon.

entries.name: 🔱 Noble
entries.content:
### Nobles:
- Overview: Aristocratic, hereditary, high political/economic/social status, requires birth/marriage into House. Titles: duke, marquess, count, viscount, baron. Some demon infiltration.
- Appearance: Commonly vibrant blue eyes and blond hair.
Personality: Often prideful, greedy, snobbish, corrupt; control others through wealth/influence. Lower-rank: humbler, sensible.
- Abilities: High-level from high-quality cuisine, marrying strong individuals; some demons feed on negative feelings.
- Trivia:Many Belzerg nobles descended from Japanese reincarnates with cheat items, high stats; Low-ranked: no middle names; High-ranked: perverted tendencies; Year-end vacations to avoid taxes, hobby: sexually harassing maids; Crime to attack higher-ranked nobles.

entries.name: 🔱  Known Noble Households
entries.content:
### Known Noble Households:
**Kingdom of Belzerg:**
- Belzerg Clan, House Dustiness, House Alexei, House Symphonia, House Kourusurou, House Tranzam, House Klein, House Crow, House Lundberg, House Donnelly, House Greedo, House Sumer, House Crank, House Predule, House Karpas, House Primo

**Kingdom of Elroad:**
- Elroad Clan, House Reuentahl

**Kingdom of Brydle:**
- Brydle Clan, House Sheyka

entries.name: 🌟 Reincarnated People
entries.content:
### Reincarnated People:
- Earthling citizens reincarnated by Aqua to slay the Devil King. Identifiable by black hair, dark eyes, "weird" names, and cheat abilities or items from Aqua.

entries.name: 🔴 Crimson Demons
entries.content:
### Crimson Demons:
- Modified humans with high Intellect and Magical Power. Features include red eyes, dark hair, pale skin, weird names, and a random bar code tattoo.

entries.name: 🐾 Beastmen
entries.content:
### Beastmen:
- Demi-humans with animal ears and tails, rarely seen. In "KonoSuba: Fantastic Days," live in the Northern Land as farmers.

entries.name: 🔨 Dwarves
entries.content:
### Dwarves:
- Rough, stout, and tough demi-humans with high longevity. Known for Poison Resistance, Smithing skills, and drinking habits. They grow beards by sloppiness or shave for sanitary reasons.

entries.name: 🍃 Elves
entries.content:
### Elves:
- Noble and handsome race with pure-blood members having long ears. Divided into:
  - Forest Elves: Vegetarians living in tree tops, skilled with bows, small-breasted due to sarashi use.
  - Prairie Elves: Hunters living in bare lands, skilled with spears, robust bodies, and sun-tanned skin, nicknamed "Dark Elves."
  - Their differing diets and bust sizes cause hostility.

entries.name: 🐉 Half-Dragons
entries.content:
### Half-Dragons:
- Humanoids capable of breathing fire, cross between human and dragon.

entries.name: ☀️ Gods
entries.content:
### Gods:
- Divine beings from Heaven presiding over specific domains, often beautiful and noble in appearance.

- Rivalries:
  - Gods vs. Demons from Hell, Disdain for undead.

- Abilities
 - Faith Power, Immortality, Blessing, Divine Punishment, Divine Protection, Omniscience,  Aspect, Undead/Demon Detection, Holy Aura, Mortal Form

- Parallel World Gods
  - Aqua, Eris, Wolbach, Regina

- Other Gods
  - Amaterasu, Goddess of Silver and Gold, Astroborg, Stargnoc, Zenarith

entries.name: 👹 Demons
entries.content:
### Demons:
- Immortals from Hell, feeding on human emotions. Can appear human with demonic traits, demonic beasts, or even objects.

entries.name: 😈 Devils
entries.content:
### Devils:
- Tribe of the Devil King, characterized by demonic traits and cheat skills like the reincarnated Japanese.

entries.name: 🎤 Axel Hearts
entries.content:
### Axel Hearts

**Overview:**
- Idol Unit of Adventurers: Started in Axel.
- Formation: Lia, Cielo, and Erika formed the unit, performing around Axel while adventuring. The best idol unit in the kingdom.

**Achievements:**
- The unit performed at other settlements, including Arcanletia, the Crimson Demon Village, and even the Royal Capital.

**Members:**
- Lia
- Cielo
- Erika

**Producer:**
- Satou Kazuma

**Songs:**
- Bright Show
- Dear Tomorrow
- My Favorite!
- Smile Surprise (with Mel)
- Cutie Star

entries.name: 📚 Fictional Books
entries.content:
### Fictional Books:
- The Unfettered Lord: A parody series read by Megumin and Yunyun.
- The Unfettered Lord, Volume 2: Continued adventures featuring a fake lord.
- Yours name is: Romance novel, rip-off of "Your Name."
- Avoiding Brother-in-law in the Centre of the Devil Realm: Romance novel, rip-off of "Crying Out Love in the Centre of the World."
- I Want to Eat You and Intestines: Romance novel, rip-off of "I Want to Eat Your Pancreas."

entries.name: 📖 Non-Fictional Books
entries.content:
### Non-Fictional Books:
- Forbidden Magic Tome: Allows making friends.
- Secrets of the Crimson Demons' Genesis: History of the Crimson Demons.
- The Usefulness of Explosion Magic: Lists disadvantages of Explosion Magic.
- Fishes can become Friends too: Studies on making friends with fish.
- Goblins can hold Conversations too: Goblin communication guide.
- Let's become Friends with Monsters: Guide to befriending monsters.
- Plants can become Friends too: Claims cacti have feelings.
- Gathering Friends by Binding them with Curses: Curses and friendship.
- A Certain Necro's Note: Parody of "A Certain Magical Index" and "Death Note."
- Vocabulary of the Affluent that even Goblins can Understand: Studied by Aqua.
- The Complete Guide to Elves: Encyclopedia on elves and relationships with Japanese reincarnates.

entries.name: 📜 Tales
entries.content:
### Tales:
- The Fairy Tale of Satou: Story of a cheat-using adventurer.
- Heroic Tales of the Crimson Demons: Ongoing saga by Arue, predicting the clan's destruction and Yunyun's fate.
- The Tortoise and the Hare: Dark fable based on a known tale.
- The Ugly Little Orc: Tale about an orc child seeking revenge.

entries.name: 🎭 Theatre
entries.content:
### Theatre:
- Punchin' Potemkin Brawls to Victory: Theatrical performance on Baron Potemkin's exploits.

entries.name: 🖼️ Artworks
entries.content:
### Artworks:
- Exploding Man amongst the Glittering Sunset: Painting by Gilbert Klein.
- Goddess Playing: Fountain statue inspired by Aqua.
- Transforming Combining Dendro Maiden: Robot model built by Aqua.
- Goddess Transformer Eris: Paper napkin figure by Aqua for Mitsurugi.

entries.name: 🎮 Games
entries.content:
### Games:
- Imitation Chess: Chess-like boardgame with RPG elements.
- Young Grandchild: Card game similar to Old Maid, with battle elements.

entries.name: 🎉 Festivals
entries.content:
### Festivals:
- Eris Appreciation Festival: Annual summer festival with fireworks.
- Immortal Festival: Summer festival akin to Bon Odori, hosted by Wiz.
- Harvest Festival: Rare event where adventurers harvest crops.

entries.name: 🍽️ Culinary
entries.content:
### Culinary (Dish, Cook):
- Fried Frogs: Deep-fried Giant Toad meat, a common delicacy.
- Bubbly(Schwa schwa): Alcoholic beverage similar to beer.
- Arcan Manju: Tasty bun popular among tourists.
- Stew with the Blessing of the Dark God: Vegetable stew with an overblown name.
- Spicy Spaghetti in the Style of Lava Dragons' Breath: Chili-topped spaghetti.
- Sandwich of Lamb sacrificed to the Demon God: Lamb sandwich with an overblown name.
- Bloodstained Watermelon of Purgatory: Watermelons grown in Crimson Demon Village.
- Ogre Killer: Rare powerful alcoholic drink brewed by Ogres.

entries.name: 💀 List of Monster Types - Part 1
entries.content:
### List of Monster Types - Part 1:

**Magic Beasts**:
- Monsters infesting the world, ranging from low intelligence instinct-driven creatures to highly intelligent beings. Some possess almost human-like intelligence and can understand human language.
- **Divine Beasts**: Four revered creatures: Treasure Island, Phoenix, Dragons, White Tiger
  - Based on Chinese Four Symbols constellations.

**Demi-Humans:**
- Dangerous humanoid races threatening humans. They have human-like intelligence, can communicate, use weapons, and reproduce with humans (e.g., Orcs). Many serve the Devil King's Army.

**Undead:**
- Immoral monsters turned against divine laws. Can be destroyed by divine power. Track living beings by vital energy and gather in dark places. Attracted to holy auras seeking salvation.

entries.name: 💀 List of Monster Types - Part 2
entries.content:
### List of Monster Types - Part 2:

**Demons:**
- Creatures from hell opposing the gods, feeding on living emotions. Genderless but possess traits of both sexes. Have "extra lives" to be reborn after death, measured by evil deeds. High magic resistance but weak against holy magic.

**Spirits:**
- Beings without true bodies, taking forms based on people's subconscious. Elementals (Water, Fire, Wind, Earth) inspired by Paracelsus:
  - **Fire Spirits**: Salamanders
  - **Water Spirits**: Nymphs
- Immune to non-enchanted physical damage. The Elemental Master class uses sprites to create phenomena.

**Dragons:**
- Most powerful monster type, known for hoarding shiny items. Upon defeat, often yield treasure. Some are intelligent and can negotiate with humans.

entries.name: 💀 List of Monster Types - Part 3
entries.content:
### List of Monster Types - Part 3:

**Plants:**
- Magic vegetables fight to avoid being eaten. Farmers risk lives to grow them. Various attack methods and higher XP/prices in harsh environments. Some fish (e.g., anchovy) treated like vegetables, with fruits like bananas and watermelons coming from water bodies.

**Animals:**
- Regular animals are stronger than Earth's, seen as monsters by reincarnated Japanese. Some (e.g., lobsters) are aggressive and troublesome. Others use magic (e.g., light/dark fish). Some sea animals, like octopi, live on land as cattle.
- Notable Animals: Lizards, Monkeys, Boars, Deers, Sea Lions, Crayfish, Shrimp

entries.name: Giant Toads
entries.content:
### Giant Toads
- Massive toad-like monster. To have strength to lay their eggs during mating season, they migrate to towns after food. They usually hibernate in Winter. They hate metal. They also have tough, but delicious, meat.

entries.name: Cabbages
entries.content:
### Cabbages
- Vegetables able to fly and with tons of experience. Get more flavourful as the harvest approaches, but head to the sea in this season in order to die in an unknown land without getting eaten. Sometimes Lettuces may fly among them.

entries.name: Lettuces
entries.content:
### Lettuces
- Vegetables like Cabbages that are capable of flying, but are also worth much less. They sometimes fly among migrating Cabbages.

entries.name: Zombie Makers
entries.content:
### Zombie Makers
- A type of evil spirit that has the ability to control zombies. They possess dead bodies of good quality, and they can also control many zombies at once. Their abilities differ depending on the corpse they've possessed, but their potential is always limited by the fact that they are ultimately just evil spirits.

entries.name: Zombies
entries.content:
### Zombies
- Corpses with rotten flesh that continue to walk because of lingering regrets of the like.

entries.name: Liches
entries.content:
### Liches
- The No-Life Kings, mages who mastered the limits of magic, abandoning their natural bodies through an arcane ritual. They usually look like skeletons.

entries.name: Ghosts
entries.content:
### Ghosts
- Undead beings that have lost their physical body. They look like bluish-white humanlike figures.

entries.name: Dullahans
entries.content:
### Dullahans
- Headless undead riders and heralds of death whose strength and abilities surpass the ones they possessed while alive. They're high ranked undead, under liches and vampires.

entries.name: Brutal Alligators
entries.content:
### Brutal Alligators
- Large, carnivorous reptiles. With their big, strong jaws, they devour fish in the water or any small animals that enter it. They like to move in packs and will surround spotted prey before attacking. They inhabit impure water.

entries.name: Undead Knights
entries.content:
### Undead Knights
- Corpses of fallen knights that rise as an undead monster. Top class zombies, using decaying armors.

entries.name: Wyverns
entries.content:
### Wyverns
- Bipedal winged dragons. They are not as strong as true dragons. They're large, capable of flight and possessing a stinger at the end of their tails that produce a powerful paralytic venom.

entries.name: Ropers,Roper
entries.content:
### Ropers
- Squirming tentacle monsters that hide in dark spaces in order to attack women, doing unspeakable things to them.

entries.name: Bamboos
entries.content:
### Bamboos
- Plants with sharp stalks that stab up from the ground at people who try to eat them.

entries.name: Tomatoes
entries.content:
### Tomatoes
- Vegetables able to fly that are grown in hot climates.

entries.name: Snow Sprites
entries.content:
### Snow Sprites
- Fluffy white ball at the size of a palm. They are weak monsters that live in snow fields. Each time one dies, the spring comes a half day earlier.

entries.name: Winter Shogun
entries.content:
### Winter Shogun
- The Lord of the Snow Sprites and Spirit of the Winter itself. Doesn't have a real body, but assumes the form a human form, wearing a white samurai-styled helmet and an intricate warrior's surcoat. Appears when Snow Sprites are killed.

entries.name: Goblins
entries.content:
### Goblins
- Dangerous demi-humans that walk in pack of maximum 14 members and use weapons. They are as tall as younger grade-schoolers, but violent and quick-moving.

entries.name: Beginner's Banes
entries.content:
### Beginner's Banes
- Catlike creatures bigger than lions or tigers, with black fur, golden eyes, two long fangs and huge fangs. Smart monsters that hang out with goblins and kobolds and use them as bait for rookies. There are herbivorous Beginner's Bane with crimson eyes that enjoy eating wolfberries.

entries.name: Gremlins
entries.content:
### Gremlins
- Low-ranked demons with small, humanoid bodies. They pop up in places where magic power is thick, such as dungeons.

entries.name: Dungeon Mimics
entries.content:
### Dungeon Mimics
- They can look like a treasure chest or a pile of gold, eating anyone who steps on to reach it. They attack both humans and other monsters.

entries.name: Succubi
entries.content:
### Succubi
- Demons who look like busty women and feed on men's vitality, giving men erotic dreams.

entries.name: Golems
entries.content:
### Golems
- Automatons inhabited by magic with different names and shapes depending on their function. They usually have a magic rune engraved on their forehead, which is their power source. Earth Golems created by Creator class have a short lifespan.

entries.name: Neroids
entries.content:
### Neroids
- Mysterious drinkable fizzy lifeforms used as substitutes for carbonation in drinks. They prefer dark areas, and have various subspecies, like Pink Neroids, Emerald Neroids, Crimson Neroids and Hell Neroids.

entries.name: Powerful Messenger
entries.content:
### Powerful Messenger
- An earth spirit that looks like a tentacular monster with no visible eyes similar to an evil god of Cthulhu Mythos.

entries.name: Ghouls
entries.content:
### Ghouls
- Humanoid undead creatures capable of agile movements and that have paralyzing poison in their claws. They feed on carrion to live.

entries.name: Vampires
entries.content:
### Vampires
- High-ranked undeads with red eyes and sharp fangs, under liches and above dullahans, those can turn those who they suck blood into undead. If someone with a pure body who has never performed sexual acts before has their blood sucked by a vampire, they will become a Lesser Vampire.

entries.name: White Tigers
entries.content:
### White Tigers
- Gigantic tigers bearing pure white fur, it's a divine beast with impressive mobility and speed, and a holy aura.

entries.name: Vanir Dolls
entries.content:
### Vanir Dolls
- Masked biped dolls at the size of the knee. They stick to people who are moving and explode.

entries.name: Demons
entries.content:
### Demons
- The tribe from Hell who opposes the gods, don't posses a lifespan, but can have "extra lives". They survive by feeding on people's emotions.

entries.name: Sirens
entries.content:
### Sirens
- Female-type monsters whose lower bodies are that of a bird and sing to charm people. They're friendly sea spirits.

entries.name: Lizard Runners
entries.content:
### Lizard Runners
- Herbivorous bipedal lizards that, once a female, called Princess Runner, are born, they compete for her by running and causing all sort of trouble.

entries.name: Red Dragons
entries.content:
### Red Dragons
- Dragons with red scales, two horns and huge wings. They have fire attribute, being resistant to fire and weak against ice.

entries.name: Running Hawkites
entries.content:
### Running Hawkites
- Hybrids of hawks and black kites. Can't fly but can run at high speeds. To impress the female, they realize the "Chicken Run", running into the hardest thing the found and avoiding it at the last second.

entries.name: Slimes
entries.content:
### Slimes
- Living creatures composed of stick, viscous fluid. Aside from the small ones, slimes are powerful adversaries, immune to physical attacks, highly resistant to magic and eating anything they stick on, by dissolving them on their weakly acid body. They have different subtypes, like the Poison Slime, which is toxic, and the Paralyze Slime, which secrets paralyze venom. They are also artificial variants, like the Gelatinous Slime, that can be eaten.

entries.name: One-Punch Bears
entries.content:
### One-Punch Bears
- Large bears with a very violent disposition. The massive claws on its forelegs are sharp enough to behead unprepared targets. Because of this, they are not only feared by regular people, but also by adventurers.

entries.name: Mine Mushrooms
entries.content:
### Mine Mushrooms
- Small mushrooms that, in the presence of strong magic, explode violently.

entries.name: Nightmares
entries.content:
### Nightmares
- Low-ranked demons that take the form of a pitch-black stallion and bestow nightmares onto others in order to feast on their dark emotions.

entries.name: Frog Killers
entries.content:
### Frog Killers
- Large snakes that inhabit deep forests and lakesides, hunting Giant Toads. They're capable of covering ground with surprising speed, and with large muscular bodies capable of crushing a Giant Toad to death.

entries.name: White Wolves
entries.content:
### White Wolves
- Carnivorous monsters that walk on packs and only appear in the winter. They frequently fight with One-Punch Bears.

entries.name: Great Spirits of the Storm
entries.content:
### Great Spirits of the Storm
- High level spirits related to water spirits, appearing as semi-transparent girls with wavy blue hair. Responsible for storms and typhoons in summer.

entries.name: Thief Monkeys
entries.content:
### Thief Monkeys
- Monkeys notorious for stealing things.

entries.name: Tranquility Girls
entries.content:
### Tranquility Girls
- Monster plants appearing as injured little girls to fool adventurers into protecting them. Victims become malnourished and eventually die, with the monster using the corpses as fertilizer. Offshoot of Alraunes.

entries.name: Orcs
entries.content:
### Orcs
- Pigheaded demi-humans with strong bodies and high fertility. Rare male orcs often traumatized by female orcs, who reproduce with any humanoid male by kidnapping.

entries.name: Onis
entries.content:
### Onis
- Demi-humans with pointed ears, dark-red skin, and a single forehead horn. Not true lesser demons.

entries.name: Chimeras
entries.content:
### Chimeras
- Artificial weapons composed of various creature parts, both organic and inorganic.

entries.name: Dire Bunnies / Lovely Bunnies
entries.content:
### Dire Bunnies / Lovely Bunnies
- Fluffy, horned bunnies that appear cute but are carnivorous monsters.

entries.name: Gargoyles
entries.content:
### Gargoyles
- Humanoid demons with sharp claws, black fur, bat-like wings, and reptilian faces with birdlike beaks.

entries.name: Mandrakes
entries.content:
### Mandrakes
- Plant monsters prized for potion ingredients. Their screech can kill anyone who hears it when pulled from the ground.

entries.name: Duxions
entries.content:
### Duxions
- Rare, cute duck-like monsters that carry onions and have curative properties, worth a lot of experience points.

entries.name: Potatoes
entries.content:
### Potatoes
- Flying vegetables. Wild breeds are aggressive, attacking in groups. Sprouts are highly poisonous.

entries.name: Fire Drakes
entries.content:
### Fire Drakes
- Massive reptiles with flame-colored scales and fire breath.

entries.name: Giant Earthworms
entries.content:
### Giant Earthworms
- Large, blind, pink, soft-bodied carnivorous earthworms.

entries.name: Giant Bats
entries.content:
### Giant Bats
- Raptors-sized bats dwelling in caves or abandoned buildings, attacking humans and animals at night.

entries.name: Chestnut Rats
entries.content:
### Chestnut Rats
- Dog-sized monsters covered in thorns, invading farms to eat chestnuts.

entries.name: Bloody Squirrels
entries.content:
### Bloody Squirrels
- Flying, carnivorous squirrels marking victims with a smell lasting a week.

entries.name: Octopi
entries.content:
### Octopi
- Tentacled creatures farmed on land, often wrapping around women, capable of color changes.

entries.name: Pandas
entries.content:
### Pandas
- Ferocious black and white beasts eating bamboo leaves and meat.

entries.name: Ogres
entries.content:
### Ogres
- Tall, horned man-eating demi-humans with strong instincts and bonds with kin.

entries.name: Kobolds
entries.content:
### Kobolds
- Bipedal dog-like demi-humans in nests. Dangerous by grouping, can overwhelm novice adventurers.

entries.name: Giant Squids
entries.content:
### Giant Squids
- Huge squids that jump to hug people's faces.

entries.name: Krakens
entries.content:
### Krakens
- Giant octopus monsters dwelling in the sea.

entries.name: Kowloon Hydra
entries.content:
### Kowloon Hydra
- Water-dwelling dragon variant with eight heads, absorbs MP from surroundings.

entries.name: Adaman Snails
entries.content:
### Adaman Snails
- Giant snails invulnerable to physical attacks, appear during rainy season.

entries.name: Incubi
entries.content:
### Incubi
- Male dream demons with bat wings, lush hair, piercings, makeup, and eye shadow.

entries.name: Explosion Stones
entries.content:
### Explosion Stones
- Rocks with human-like faces that explode when hit.

entries.name: Trolls
entries.content:
### Trolls
- Hulking, forest-dwelling, green-skinned behemoths known for durability and self-healing.

entries.name: Owl Monsters
entries.content:
### Owl Monsters
- Owl-like flying monsters with human eyes.

entries.name: Minotaurs
entries.content:
### Minotaurs
- Muscular demi-humans with bull heads, living in caves, wielding axes.

entries.name: Weeds
entries.content:
### Weeds
- Creatures that explode when touched, shooting seeds.

entries.name: Dryads
entries.content:
### Dryads
- Forest spirits resembling green-haired girls, speaking Elvish, controlling plants.

entries.name: Fairies
entries.content:
### Fairies
- Small, butterfly-winged, naked girl-like creatures, innocent and naive, with high-quality condiment scales.

entries.name: Cattle Fungi
entries.content:
### Cattle Fungi
- Fungi infecting animals, driving aggressive behavior.

entries.name: Cicadas
entries.content:
### Cicadas
- Monsters living a month, louder than Earth versions, chirp constantly.

entries.name: Stag Beetles
entries.content:
### Stag Beetles
- Dog-sized beetles that charge with horns.

entries.name: Green Dragons
entries.content:
### Green Dragons
- Giant, sharp-fanged lizard-like monsters with green scales and dual horns.

entries.name: Destroyer Prototype
entries.content:
### Destroyer Prototype
- Giant, eight-legged, spider-like golem bigger than a person, similar to the Destroyer.

entries.name: Assault Ants
entries.content:
### Assault Ants
- Behemoth insects ferociously charging at enemies, digging nests like extensive cave systems.

entries.name: Wizard Predators
entries.content:
### Wizard Predators
- Mechanical serpents, bane to wizards and magic users.

entries.name: Kesaran Pasarans
entries.content:
### Kesaran Pasarans
- Fluffy floaty puffballs, cousins to Snow Sprites. Attacks summon a protecting Great Spirit.

entries.name: Zombie Dragons
entries.content:
### Zombie Dragons
- Undead dragons without breath abilities, stronger due to immortality.

entries.name: Werewolves
entries.content:
### Werewolves
- Demi-humans shifting between wolf and human forms, blending into human society.

entries.name: Griffins
entries.content:
### Griffins
- Horse-sized, lion-bodied, eagle-headed flying monsters.

entries.name: Killer Bees
entries.content:
### Killer Bees
- Massive bees with potent sting venom.

entries.name: Golden Dragons
entries.content:
### Golden Dragons
- Valuable electric dragons with golden scales, attracted to shiny objects, inhabiting mines.

entries.name: Skeletons
entries.content:
### Skeletons
- Animated bones of the deceased, minor undead threats.

entries.name: Bell Peppers
entries.content:
### Bell Peppers
- Red magical beings, playing dead when harvested, attacking unsuspecting cooks.

entries.name: Antlions
entries.content:
### Antlions
- Monsters hiding underground, attacking from below.

entries.name: Wraith
entries.content:
### Wraith
- Semi-transparent ghosts, human-like, communicating telepathically.

entries.name: Tranquility Queen
entries.content:
### Tranquility Queen
- Plant beings as beautiful women with vegetation bodies, forest roots. Higher form of Tranquility Girls.

entries.name: Manticores
entries.content:
### Manticores
- Chimera-like subspecies wyverns, human head, lion body,bat wings, and a scorpion's tail. Females are stronger than males.

entries.name: Genbu
entries.content:
### Genbu
- Giant, docile turtles the size of mountains, living underground, surfacing every ten years for shell drying. Eat rare gems, with shells containing valuable minerals, nicknamed "Treasure Island". A divine beast.

entries.name: Rock Mimics
entries.content:
### Rock Mimics
- Creatures blending into rocks, resembling grey octopuses.

entries.name: Mushrooms
entries.content:
### Mushrooms
- Small, black magical beings that fly and attack using spores.

entries.name: Cherry Blossoms Spirits
entries.content:
### Cherry Blossoms Spirits
- Appearing nude when cherry blossoms bloom.

entries.name: Fenrirs
entries.content:
### Fenrirs
- Large silver wolves with blue eyes, manipulating ice. Can devastate veteran adventurer parties. Higher forms of White Wolves.

entries.name: Mad Bomber Moguninnin
entries.content:
### Mad Bomber Moguninnin
- Two-legged ninja-like robots using explosion magic, hating humans with black hair and eyes, particularly those in harem parties.

entries.name: Alraunes
entries.content:
### Alraunes
- Monster plants resembling young girls sprouting from giant flowers, immobilizing prey to implant seeds, later consuming corpses as fertilizer.

entries.name: Elder Treants
entries.content:
### Elder Treants
- Massive plant monsters resembling rotting, animated trees.

entries.name: Scarosaurus
entries.content:
### Scarosaurus
- Large, cow-sized lizards absorbing and converting ice magic for strength.

entries.name: Magic Eaters
entries.content:
### Magic Eaters
- Spirit-type monsters looking like glowing lights, consuming magic, usually found near strong monsters.

entries.name: King Toads
entries.content:
### King Toads
- Humongous frogs the size of small mansions with regenerative abilities. Appearing during strong rainy seasons, rumored to end the season when defeated.

entries.name: Crystal Ligers
entries.content:
### Crystal Ligers
- Larger herbivorous cat monsters than Beginner's Banes, attracted to shiny items, especially jewels. Evolved form of Beginner's Banes.

entries.name: White Dragons
entries.content:
### White Dragons
- Nearly extinct dragons with pure white bodies and red eyes, possessing holy attributes and magic. Intelligent and docile. Bones and fangs believed to bring luck.

entries.name: Blue-Crabs
entries.content:
### Blue-Crabs
- Monsters traveling long distances protected by hard shells, inhabiting waters.

entries.name: Cerberus
entries.content:
### Cerberus
- Giant three-headed dogs with fire-controlling abilities, fur always warm.

entries.name: Harpies
entries.content:
### Harpies
- Magic beasts, half-human, half-bird.

entries.name: Centaurs
entries.content:
### Centaurs
- Demi-humans with human upper bodies and horse lower bodies.

entries.name: Medusa
entries.content:
### Medusa
- Monsters with snake hair, petrifying others.

entries.name: Kobold Heroes
entries.content:
### Kobold Heroes
- Advanced Kobolds posing threats to intermediate adventurers.

entries.name: Grimm Reapers
entries.content:
### Grimm Reapers
- Floating skeletons wielding scythes, clad in frayed black robes.

entries.name: Wild Demon Salmons
entries.content:
### Wild Demon Salmons
- Salmon-like monsters intensely protect offspring, causing storm clouds with water magic.

entries.name: Great Spirit of Summer
entries.content:
### Great Spirit of Summer
- Spirits causing summer heatwaves, retaliating against weather changers.

entries.name: Onions
entries.content:
### Onions
- Magic creatures attacking with tear magic instead of flying.

entries.name: Fortress Tortoises
entries.content:
### Fortress Tortoises
- Tortoises storing vast nutrients in shells.

entries.name: Great Kings of Terror
entries.content:
### Great Kings of Terror
- Vengeful, painful cockroach-like monsters attacking those who kill one sleeping.

entries.name: Sea Serpents
entries.content:
### Sea Serpents
- Snake-like sea monsters with poisonous blood.

entries.name: Leviathans
entries.content:
### Leviathans
- Highly intelligent dragon-like monsters with hard scales and water breath. Offspring similar to sea serpents.

entries.name: Giant Rats
entries.content:
### Giant Rats
- Huge rats.

entries.name: Basilisks
entries.content:
### Basilisks
- Multi-legged reptiles with petrifying abilities.

entries.name: Salamanders
entries.content:
### Salamanders
- Heat-generating lizards.

entries.name: Black Hounds
entries.content:
### Black Hounds
- Demonic dogs symbolizing ill omen and death.

entries.name: Giant Spiders
entries.content:
### Giant Spiders
- Enormous spiders trapping prey in large webs.

entries.name: Arachnes
entries.content:
### Arachnes
- Monsters with woman upper bodies and giant spider lower bodies.

entries.name: Giant Seaweeds
entries.content:
### Giant Seaweeds
- Seaweed-type monsters, natural enemies of kelp.

entries.name: Sweet Potatoes
entries.content:
### Sweet Potatoes
- Adorable jumping sweet vegetables, popular in autumn.

entries.name: 🙏 Amaterasu
entries.content:
### Amaterasu:
- The Shinto Sun Goddess Amaterasu is referenced as a goddess who became a NEET and locked herself in a cave, while the other gods throw a party to get her out.

entries.name: 🙏 Goddess of Silver and Gold
entries.content:
### Goddess of Silver and Gold:
- According to the Crimson Demons, people can summon the Goddess of Silver and Gold by offering axes and coins to their Wishing Pond.

entries.name: 🙏 Astroborg
entries.content:
### Astroborg:
- According to Megumin, her sister is the incarnation of Astroborg, the God of Violent Hunger.

entries.name: 🙏 Stargnoc
entries.content:
### Stargnoc:
- A running gag is that Megumin claims to have been the Goddess of Destruction in her previous life. In the game Fantastic Days this god is named as Stargnoc (Utodemeo)

entries.name: 🙏 Zenarith
entries.content:
### Zenarith:
- According to Natsume Akatsuki, Zenarith, the Goddess of Undeath and Disaster mentioned in Combatants Will Be Dispatched! and Kemono Michi: Rise Up, is Regina's sister.

entries.name: 🙏 Regina
entries.content:
### Regina:
- Minor dark god that presides over Puppetry and Revenge. 
- Her sister is Zenarith.
-  She has an abandoned church on the outskirts of Axel, near a mountainside.
- She was once followed by a spectre named Lucy, who died a priestess for Regina but remained a ghost to preserve her goddess' existence.tinymites.
-  One of the central teachings in her religion is; "Do as is done unto you", reflecting her authority over revenge.
- She is referenced as "the goddess of vengeance and domination whose name has been forgotten."

entries.name: ✝️ 엑시스(아쿠시즈) 교
entries.content:
### Axis Order (Axis Cult / Axis Church / Akushizu Order):

**Overview:**
- Minor Religion: Reveres the Goddess Aqua, rival to Eris Order.
- Followers: Few hundred globally; often use schemes for conversion.
- Headquarters: Arcanletia, known for aggressive conversion methods and managing city’s water.

** Faith:**
- Principles: Permissive cult, promotes forgiveness.
- Teachings: Accept lolicons, NEETs, furries, etc., as long as they're not interested in undead or demons and don’t break the law.
- Beliefs: Advocates taking the easiest way, avoiding responsibilities, blaming external factors, and eschewing self-control.
- Afterlife: Followers believe in reincarnation to Japan, embraced by otaku culture.

**Members:**
- Goddess: Aqua

### Eris Order (Eris Cult / Eris Church):

**Faith:**
- Revered Deity: Eris, the Goddess of Fortune.

**Information:**
- National Faith: Predominant religion in the Kingdom of Belzerg; nobility, including the Dustiness family, are faithful followers.
- Eris Appreciation Festival: Annual summer festival where participants dress as Eris; believed to keep participants safe until the next festival (though it's just superstition).
- Follower Comparison: Eris Order has more followers, but Axis Order followers are more fanatical, giving Aqua more power than Eris.
- Holy Site: City of Axel, regarded as holy after Eris's public descent.

**Members:**
- Goddess: Eris
- Clergy: Rosary (Arch-priest), Thomas (Priest), Maris (Priest)
